artifacts.notes: Identifies one unusually ornate revival-style pectoral cross made for exhibition in 1900, with an integral bail and suspension chain. It controls only this exemplar's identity, materials, measured dimensions, and visible construction; it does not establish ordinary episcopal morphology or whether a chain or cord governs a particular dress context.
